annotations.title: Mark many threads read or unread

description: Mark up to 50 threads read or unread in one call, each exactly as set_thread_read would. Answers one result per thread: done when a message changed, unchanged when the thread already was, notFound for an id that is not a thread of this workspace, failed for a thread that hit an error on our side (ask again). One thread failing never stops the rest. A key an owner limited to some mailboxes and agent inboxes changes only the thread's copies in those.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

threadIds.description: The threads, by id: at least 1 and at most 50. A repeated id counts once.
